name: The District at Tustin Legacy
summary: Large outdoor mall with a wide variety of dining options, plus retail stores & regular events.
description: The District at Tustin Legacy is a vibrant open-air lifestyle destination featuring premier shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences in the heart of Orange County. This upscale center offers a carefully curated mix of national retailers, local boutiques, and destination restaurants in a beautifully designed pedestrian-friendly environment.
demographics: The District attracts affluent Orange County families and young professionals, with a primary trade area featuring median household incomes exceeding $100,000 and a strong representation of college-educated residents aged 25-54. The center serves Tustin, Irvine, and surrounding communities known for their high-income demographics and preferences for lifestyle-oriented shopping experiences. Visitors typically engage in multi-purpose trips combining shopping, dining, and entertainment, with strong weekend traffic from families and weeknight activity from the nearby business community.
